'''RamapoCon III''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament weekend held in 2001, the third RamapoCon after [[RamapoCon II]] (May 2000). It included a two-day Decipher Player Championship (DPC), an Open and a team tournament. Don Kitzman won the DPC<ref name="dt-16690">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16690 I'm Sorry Too], DeckTech (Don "Chef" Kitzman, 12 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16690/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16690/ GitHub Pages].</ref> and [[Hayes Hunter]] won the Open.<ref name="dt-16746">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16746 Hayes' Brilliant Pile], DeckTech (Hayes Hunter, 14 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16746/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16746/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 12 June)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''DPC winner:''' Don Kitzman
* '''Open winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts of 12–26 June 2001; they give no exact date or site. It was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal.

Kitzman posted his Dark deck as the one that "helped me win Ramapo DPC"; [[Alan Sagan]]'s only day-1 loss was to "Don Kitzman's Speed deal".<ref name="dt-16690" /><ref name="dt-16877" /> Sagan finished 9th on day 1 and 14th on day 2 of the DPC.<ref name="dt-16877" /> Hunter posted his Light deck as his "RamapoCon 3 winning light deck" and won the final of the Open by 29; Lingrell was runner-up, losing the final duel to Hunter.<ref name="dt-16746" /><ref name="dt-16702" /> Lewis wrote that his Hidden Base deck went undefeated at RamapoCon 3, with one game going to time against [[Bastian Winkelhaus]]; the post does not say which event.<ref name="dt-17021" /> Kessling and Adam Drake played his Light deck over the weekend; he lost only three games, to [[Charlie Herren]], Dominic from Canada and Ed, and beat Mike Dalton in the DPC.<ref name="dt-16874" /> [[Justin Desai]] went 3–1 in both the DPC and the Open with his Light deck.<ref name="dt-16682" /> [[Mike Gemme]] posted a Dark deck he and "steebo" used at Ramapo, with no result.<ref name="dt-16821">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16821 Why I Beat Steven Lewis's Girlfriend], DeckTech (Michael "Deck" Gemme, 18 June 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16821/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16821/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
